ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, the Interest Coverage Ratio was 5.47:1.
At September 30, 2026, the leverage ratio was 2.34:1.

parsed.notes: Interest coverage is Adjusted EBIT per the Credit Facility to interest expense (TTM), minimum 2.75:1. Leverage is funded debt to TTM Adjusted EBITDA, maximum 3.5:1; it may step up to 4.0:1 for four quarters after a Material Acquisition. The filing gives no indication that this step-up was in effect at 2026-09-30. The company states compliance at both 2026-09-30 and 2026-06-30, but gives actual ratios only for 2026-09-30.
